title: Answer
description:
The older speech was already mouth to mouth, and the hearer's life already hung on it. The Son takes up that speech, not a clearer version of a vague one.

The inheritance is the nations and the ages, given in the same decree that names Him Son.

Glory that had to be veiled was never this brightness. The carrying of a people is the carrying that belongs to the one who shares his glory with no other.

Sitting closes the work that had to be booked again next year. It is not a seat the rite ever owned, and it is not the end of the enemies.
